sar.narrative: This report details suspicious online activity involving customer C06220 and card C06220-K1. Between January 17 and January 19, 2017, three unauthorized online transactions were attempted. The transactions are: ID 3660125 on 2017-01-17 for $637.13, ID 3660126 on 2017-01-18 for $758.80, and ID 3660127 on 2017-01-19 for $770.78. These purchases were conducted using a device profile marked as new for this account and routed through an anonymous proxy. The activity is highly suspicious because the device fingerprint is spoofed, presenting itself as an Android handset (SM-J700T1) while simultaneously reporting Apple iOS operating systems (iOS 11.1.1 and 11.1.2) or blank fields. This impossible device signature has been linked to four other cards (C05061-K1, C05704-K2, C07925-K1, C11309-K1) within the same 30-day period, indicating a coordinated fraud ring. The total exposure for this card is $2,166.71.
